api-foundations.copy: Card owns the surface contract. Slots may contain components; product sequencing belongs to patterns.

props.name: title
props.notes: Visible title and accessible name source.

props.name: value
props.notes: Prominent value, status, or object summary.

props.name: unit
props.notes: Optional unit prefix for stats composition values.

props.name: detail
props.notes: Supporting text that explains scan value or recovery.

props.name: status
props.notes: Short visible status label.

props.name: trend
props.notes: Trend tone for stats composition status.

props.name: icon
props.notes: Optional approved symbol for recognition.

props.name: media
props.notes: Optional media URL for media composition.

props.name: mediaAlt
props.notes: Accessible alt text when the media carries meaning.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Surface treatment governed by Flow tokens.

props.name: composition
props.notes: Card anatomy composition informed by the ZIP reference without changing the surface variant API.

props.name: state
props.type: default | hover | focus | selected | loading | error | disabled | muted | interactive
props.notes: Resolved UI state before styling.

props.name: density
props.notes: Density context from Flow.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Allows the Card to fill its owning layout.

props.name: interactive
props.notes: Makes the whole surface keyboard/actionable when no nested actions exist.

props.name: selected
props.notes: Marks the surface as selected and syncs aria-pressed when interactive.

props.name: disabled
props.notes: Removes whole-surface activation and applies disabled state.

props.name: loading
props.notes: Shows loading state and aria-busy.

props.name: actions
props.notes: Nested Flow Button or IconButton actions; disables whole-card button behavior.

props.name: onAction
props.notes: Whole-surface action handler when Card is interactive.
